note: Adapted from Emerson's original English description of 1925 (new species Armitermes (Armitermes) grandidens, later placed in Mapinguaritermes); soldier caste only. In the original each measurement occupies a line of its own with no unit given; following that paper's convention they are in mm, and here they have been consolidated under measurement names. The page numbers are inferred from the running heads 374 and 375, the starting page 373 being an estimate.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to Armitermes peruanus Holmgren, but smaller; the proportions of the mandibular teeth are larger than shown in Holmgren's figure (1912, p. 57). The original description covers the soldier only; the nest and the reproductive castes were never found, hence there is no alate or worker description.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, roundly oval, convex in profile; the head surface usually with 6—10 setae. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 as long as segment 3, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Labrum rounded at the apex. Mandibles dark red-brown, stout and curved, about 2/3 the length of the frontal tube (nasus); the left mandible with a large, strong triangular tooth at its middle, directed slightly upward; the right mandible similar. Frontal tube long and stout, slightly reddish. Anterior margin of the pronotum yellow, the edge with long setae. Abdomen coloured by the gut contents; sternites with long hairs. Measurements: total length 7.50—8.00 mm; head length 3.21—3.37 mm; head width 1.71—1.77 mm; antennal length 2.15—2.25 mm; pronotal length 0.53—0.57 mm; pronotal width 0.96—1.03 mm; hind tibia length 1.54—1.60 mm; left mandible length 1.22 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Kartabo (British Guiana), known only from the type locality; the holotype is a soldier. The author described the species from numerous soldiers taken in two different colonies; the nest and the reproductive castes were never found (fig. 52).
